clues: Two distinct Paul and Silas are released beside empty open wooden stocks and loose chains.
Jailer kneels with a small clay oil lamp.
Heavy wooden doors stand open; all visible prisoners remain inside.
Earthquake masonry cracks and rubble are present.
Ceiling and floor pole artifacts repaired; no hard cube seams seen.
Three distinct storeys with separate floor bands.
High lamp-lit open third-storey meeting window above two middle-storey shutters.
Paul embraces one living youth on courtyard ground.
